model_assignment_policy: one assigned local Ollama model per agent at a time; do not assign or launch until exact Ollama tags are verified on the target device. Model sharing is permitted if hardware requires it; never run two local models simultaneously for one agent.

reported_model_inventory.note: The three planned pulls are not counted as installed until the user confirms successful downloads and Ollama list output.

scheduler.reason: Keep disabled until all 17 role/model mappings, QA ownership, target hardware capacity and tests are verified. One local worker at a time is the safe initial tablet profile.

notes: ChatGPT is the external overall coordinator; there is no local Trinity agent or Trinity model.
SCRIBE and LENS are two local creative-lead agents. The three QA supervisors and twelve production specialists complete the 17-local-agent target.
The 14 listed Ollama models are user-reported installed inventory, not independently verified on the target device.
Three additional model pulls are planned only; do not assume they completed.
No model is actively assigned by default. Match roles to verified model tags after the final inventory is confirmed.
Gemini and OpenRouter may be configured only as optional free-tier escalation/backup paths after credentials and limits are verified; they are not local defaults.
No paid provider fallback is implemented in this service.
QA supervisors review only their four assigned production specialists; creative-lead deliverables require independent review and may not self-approve.
The 20-minute production, 5-minute QA, 5-minute correction cadence with optional 10-minute extension remains the intended cycle.

cycle.description: 20 minutes production, 5 minutes independent QA, 5 minutes correction, with up to 10 additional minutes alternating correction and re-review when work remains.
